name: jev-codex-router
description: Install and operate Codex Auto Router (Early Access), with configurable role models and adaptive effort.

interface.shortDescription: Set up configurable Codex roles and adaptive effort.
interface.longDescription: Guides installation of the local Codex Auto Router distribution with TypeSafe/Jev or OpenCode Go classification. The plugin package does not start services or configure credentials by itself.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me install or diagnose Codex Auto Router without exposing my credentials.
